diagnosis: The Prometheus rule inspection endpoint fetches Kubernetes custom resource objects (prometheusrules) using the namespace parameter from the URL path. It authenticates current_user but does not verify whether namespace is allocated to current_user.tenant_id. An attacker can inspect monitoring expressions, alert thresholds, and internal metrics of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /k8s/namespaces/tenant-fin-core/alert-rules/high-transaction-failure HTTP/1.1
Host: monitoring.k8s-platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
